subject: journey/nautilus
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A single landscape 3:2 illustration for the historical atlas sketchbook of Jules Verne's Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea. A nineteenth-century naturalist's field sketch in graphite and sepia pen with restrained transparent watercolour washes on warm ivory paper. Fine irregular parallel hatching, economical contour lines, a few details sharply observed; leave areas of cream paper around irregular unfinished edges. One coherent scene that reads at small sizes. No captions, labels, border, binding, signatures, photorealism, modern equipment, or Disney submarine designs. View from behind Captain Nemo at the pilot wheel in a low iron pilothouse. Through thick forward windows the submarine’s electric lantern lights rough flooded rock walls sweeping past. Strong contrast of a small pale aperture surrounded by dark metal and stone. Unadorned 1860s engineering.
